spawn.name: A Quiet Alley
spawn.description:
The air hangs thick here, a peculiar mix of stale rain and the faintest scent of copper from the market on your left. You feel it clinging to the cobblestones beneath your feet, almost a wet weight pressing against you with every step. Above, a thin layer of grime covers the worn wooden beams that span the narrow space, leaving a dim shadow on the ground where light manages to reach.  The sound of hammers and haggling fades into the distance as you stand here.

To your west, the Ledgerfall Market bustles with activity - a constant flow of bartering and hurried steps echoing in the cobbled streets. To your east, an archaic door stands cracked and broken, its paint peeled away like dried scabs on aging parchment. It leans precariously against the wall, almost as if it's holding onto the very structure of the alley with a threadbare groan. A rusty hinge creaks faintly with every draft that rushes through the gap, sending ripples in the stagnant air. 

The silence here is thick and heavy, not peaceful like an empty room. It hums like the undercurrent of unseen activity around you. It doesn’t feel empty.  It feels… restrained. Like a threadbare curtain holding back something bigger.

broken_door.name: Broken Door
broken_door.description: Skittering sounds can be heard from behind the door.

ledgerfall_market.name: Ledgerfall Market
ledgerfall_market.description: To the West you see a bustling market place.
